+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9380'
+title: 'D207: the reconcile uses the public Router record-to-summary function, not a copy of the slug rule'
+---
+Follow-up of ^en1kt61 (2026-11-19).
+
+## Dependency (not on this board)
+
+Router ^abrxfy5 (01M7T179V2HYWNY596CABRXFY5), in work. It gives:
+1. a public pure `SessionSummary.init(record: SessionRecord)` that uses the same code as the directory (one slug rule);
+2. a public static `RouterSessionDirectory.recordedSummary(inSessionFolder: URL) throws -> SessionSummary?` that reads only that folder's index.md (nil when the folder has no index.md).
+The names can change a little in the Router review; wait for the final names and the sha.
+
+## Current behavior
+
+The reconcile of the transcript search index (`Search/TranscriptSearchApplier+Reconcile.swift`, `Search/TranscriptSessionMetadata.swift`) builds the session facts of each recorded session from its `index.md` record. It cannot use `summary(of:)`, because for a closed session that function reads every registered project folder, also folders that the process cannot read. The Router function that turns a record into a `SessionSummary` was internal, so the agent COPIED the slug rule (title slug, else the 7-character short id).
+
+## Change
+
+1. Use `recordedSummary(inSessionFolder:)` (or `SessionSummary(record:)`) in the reconcile.
+2. Remove the copy of the slug rule and any other copied record-to-summary code.
+3. Keep the rule: read only folders that the host says are readable.
+
+## Tests
+
+- The session item of a recorded session in the reconcile has the same name, slug and facts as `summary(of:)` gives for a live session.
+- A session with no title gets the slug of the Router (the short id), from the Router function. #d207 #search
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m7t5ymh1tt52zkf6m9w5t4rc
+  text: |-
+    Flaky test after the merge: `TranscriptSearchAgentUpdatesTests/aRecordWithNoTitleGetsTheSlugOfTheRouter` failed in a full parallel run. The slug was "default". The test expects the short id.
+
+    Cause (found with evidence, not a guess):
+    - The test closes the fixture and then removes the title from the ORIGINAL `index.md`.
+    - The fixture agent stays alive. Its `TranscriptSearchUpdates` queue (priority `.utility`) still holds changes from the prompt end and from `session/close` (`.history(summary: nil)`). Each change calls the summary reader `RouterSessionDirectory.summary(of:)`.
+    - The session is closed, so `summary(of:)` reads `recordedSummaries()`. That function gives a default name to each root session that is not live and has no title, and writes the name to `index.md` (D199 (b), `namingUntitled`). The default name for the agent `default` is "default".
+    - Under load, the queued changes run AFTER the test removes the title, so the directory writes "default" back before the reconcile reads the record.
+    - Temporary debug lines (removed after) showed the order for each failed run: `DEBUGTEST removed` -> `DEBUGREADER ... title=default` -> `DEBUGTEST reconciled slug=default`. In a passed run, the late `DEBUGREADER` came after the reconcile.
+
+    Decision: the product behavior is correct (D199: the directory names an untitled closed root on read). The reconcile does not read a stale or half-written record: `SessionIndexFile.save` keeps the old file when the save fails, and in real use the named title is the correct record. The TEST was wrong: it changed a record that a live directory of the same test can still read and name.
+
+    Fix (test only, `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/TranscriptSearchAgentUpdatesTests.swift`): the test copies the session folder into a new recording root that no session directory reads, removes the title from the copy, and reconciles that root. The purpose stays: a record with no title gets the Router slug (the short id) from `SessionSummary(record:)`. New helper `copy(sessionFolder:into:)`.
+
+    Evidence:
+    - Before: `swift test --skip-build --parallel --filter "TranscriptSearch|SessionDirectory|Fork" --maximum-repetitions 20`: the test failed 8 of 20 runs (a second debug run: 6 of 20).
+    - After: same command: 0 of 20 failed, 158 tests in 16 suites passed.
+    - Full suite `swift test --skip-build`: 2577 tests in 268 suites passed (1 known issue is the planned `withKnownIssue` in HarnessSmokeTests).
+    - `swift build --build-tests`: "Build complete!", zero compiler warnings. One build-system line stays: `warning: missing creator for mutated node ... mlx-swift_Cmlx.bundle` (llbuild, not the compiler; it was there before this change).
+
+    ### implement — changed
+    - evidence: Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/TranscriptSearchAgentUpdatesTests.swift; cause: late index updates of the fixture call `summary(of:)`, which names the untitled closed root "default" (D199)
+    - next: commit (not done here)
